objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-appx-deployment-unsigned-package-installation
objects.description: The following analytic detects attempts to install unsigned MSIX/AppX packages using the -AllowUnsigned parameter. This detection leverages Windows event logs from the AppXDeployment-Server, specifically focusing on EventID 603 which indicates the start of a deployment operation with specific deployment flags. The flag value 8388608 corresponds to the -AllowUnsigned option in PowerShell's Add-AppxPackage cmdlet. This activity is significant as adversaries have been observed leveraging unsigned M
